admission.justification: Three proving tests pin slot discovery, review-bound apply and placement protections; without them orphaned indexes would linger outside the managed root.

applicability: Citation source index discovery and deletion.
exclusions: The managed namespace; Git-tracked indexes, which list and keep.
statement: The citation-index rule scans only temp/citation-source-index and leaves publisher-shaped unmanaged slots under task notes or enclosure cache roots outside the managed subtree unlisted and undeleted.
